def process(lightningAcres, humanAcres) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    def normalize(df: pd.DataFrame, cause: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        out = df.copy()
        out.columns = [c.strip() for c in out.columns]
        # Try to find likely columns
        # Common patterns: 'Geographic Area', 'GeographicArea', 'GACC', 'Area'
        area_col = next((c for c in out.columns if c.lower().replace(' ', '') in ['geographicarea','geographic','gacc','area','region']), None)
        year_col = next((c for c in out.columns if c.lower() in ['year','fy']), None)
        acres_col = next((c for c in out.columns if 'acre' in c.lower()), None)
        if area_col is None or year_col is None or acres_col is None:
            # fall back to first 3 columns
            area_col, year_col, acres_col = out.columns[:3]
        out = out[[area_col, year_col, acres_col]].rename(columns={area_col:'geographic_area', year_col:'year', acres_col:'acres'})
        out['cause'] = cause
        out['year'] = pd.to_numeric(out['year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
        out['acres'] = pd.to_numeric(out['acres'], errors='coerce')
        out = out.dropna(subset=['geographic_area','year','acres'])
        out['geographic_area'] = out['geographic_area'].astype(str).str.strip()
        return out

    l = normalize(lightningAcres, 'lightning')
    h = normalize(humanAcres, 'human')
    all_df = pd.concat([l, h], ignore_index=True)

    # total acres burned per area-year across both causes
    area_year = all_df.groupby(['geographic_area','year'], as_index=False)['acres'].sum()

    # compute z-score within each area across years
    stats = area_year.groupby('geographic_area')['acres'].agg(['mean','std']).reset_index()
    merged = area_year.merge(stats, on='geographic_area', how='left')
    merged['z'] = (merged['acres'] - merged['mean']) / merged['std']
    merged = merged.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna(subset=['z'])

    # find max absolute z
    merged['abs_z'] = merged['z'].abs()
    top = merged.sort_values(['abs_z','geographic_area','year'], ascending=[False, True, True]).head(1)

    return top[['geographic_area','year','z','acres','mean','std','abs_z']]
input.summary: Combine lightning- and human-caused acres burned; normalize columns to [geographic_area, year, acres]; aggregate total acres by geographic_area-year; compute per-area annual acres mean and std over years; compute z-score (acres-mean)/std per area-year; select the single area-year with maximum absolute z-score and output geographic_area and year (plus diagnostics).

def process(lightningAcres, humanAcres) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    def to_long(df: pd.DataFrame, western_gb_label: str | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
        out = df.copy()

        # Standardize column names (trim whitespace)
        out.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in out.columns]

        # Fix Western Great Basin column name difference across files
        if western_gb_label is not None and western_gb_label in out.columns:
            out = out.rename(columns={western_gb_label: 'Western Great Basin'})

        if 'Year' not in out.columns:
            # Try to find year-like column
            year_col = next((c for c in out.columns if c.lower() == 'year'), None)
            if year_col is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Could not find 'Year' column. Columns={list(out.columns)}")
            out = out.rename(columns={year_col: 'Year'})

        out['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(out['Year'], errors='coerce')

        # Melt: all non-Year columns are geographic areas
        value_vars = [c for c in out.columns if c != 'Year']
        long = out.melt(id_vars=['Year'], value_vars=value_vars,
                        var_name='geographic_area', value_name='acres_raw')

        # Parse acres (allow commas, blanks)
        long['acres'] = (
            long['acres_raw']
            .astype(str)
            .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
            .str.strip()
            .replace({'': np.nan, 'nan': np.nan, 'None': np.nan})
        )
        long['acres'] = pd.to_numeric(long['acres'], errors='coerce')

        long = long.dropna(subset=['Year', 'acres'])
        long['year'] = long['Year'].astype(int)
        long['geographic_area'] = long['geographic_area'].astype(str).str.strip()

        return long[['geographic_area', 'year', 'acres']]

    # Convert both causes to long form and combine
    lightning_long = to_long(lightningAcres, western_gb_label='Western Great Basin*')
    human_long = to_long(humanAcres, western_gb_label='Western Great Basin')

    combined = pd.concat([lightning_long, human_long], ignore_index=True)

    # Total acres by geographic_area-year across both causes
    area_year = combined.groupby(['geographic_area', 'year'], as_index=False)['acres'].sum()

    # Per-area mean/std across years
    stats = area_year.groupby('geographic_area')['acres'].agg(mean='mean', std='std').reset_index()
    merged = area_year.merge(stats, on='geographic_area', how='left')

    # z-score; drop areas with std=0 or missing
    merged['z'] = (merged['acres'] - merged['mean']) / merged['std']
    merged = merged.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna(subset=['z'])

    merged['abs_z'] = merged['z'].abs()

    top = merged.sort_values(['abs_z', 'geographic_area', 'year'], ascending=[False, True, True]).head(1)

    return top[['geographic_area', 'year', 'z', 'acres', 'mean', 'std', 'abs_z']]

      def process(lightningAcres, humanAcres) -> pd.DataFrame:
          import pandas as pd
          import numpy as np
      
          def to_long(df: pd.DataFrame, western_gb_label: str | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
              out = df.copy()
      
              # Standardize column names (trim whitespace)
              out.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in out.columns]
      
              # Fix Western Great Basin column name difference across files
              if western_gb_label is not None and western_gb_label in out.columns:
                  out = out.rename(columns={western_gb_label: 'Western Great Basin'})
      
              if 'Year' not in out.columns:
                  # Try to find year-like column
                  year_col = next((c for c in out.columns if c.lower() == 'year'), None)
                  if year_col is None:
                      raise ValueError(f"Could not find 'Year' column. Columns={list(out.columns)}")
                  out = out.rename(columns={year_col: 'Year'})
      
              out['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(out['Year'], errors='coerce')
      
              # Melt: all non-Year columns are geographic areas
              value_vars = [c for c in out.columns if c != 'Year']
              long = out.melt(id_vars=['Year'], value_vars=value_vars,
                              var_name='geographic_area', value_name='acres_raw')
      
              # Parse acres (allow commas, blanks)
              long['acres'] = (
                  long['acres_raw']
                  .astype(str)
                  .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
                  .str.strip()
                  .replace({'': np.nan, 'nan': np.nan, 'None': np.nan})
              )
              long['acres'] = pd.to_numeric(long['acres'], errors='coerce')
      
              long = long.dropna(subset=['Year', 'acres'])
              long['year'] = long['Year'].astype(int)
              long['geographic_area'] = long['geographic_area'].astype(str).str.strip()
      
              return long[['geographic_area', 'year', 'acres']]
      
          # Convert both causes to long form and combine
          lightning_long = to_long(lightningAcres, western_gb_label='Western Great Basin*')
          human_long = to_long(humanAcres, western_gb_label='Western Great Basin')
      
          combined = pd.concat([lightning_long, human_long], ignore_index=True)
      
          # Total acres by geographic_area-year across both causes
          area_year = combined.groupby(['geographic_area', 'year'], as_index=False)['acres'].sum()
      
          # Per-area mean/std across years
          stats = area_year.groupby('geographic_area')['acres'].agg(mean='mean', std='std').reset_index()
          merged = area_year.merge(stats, on='geographic_area', how='left')
      
          # z-score; drop areas with std=0 or missing
          merged['z'] = (merged['acres'] - merged['mean']) / merged['std']
          merged = merged.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna(subset=['z'])
      
          merged['abs_z'] = merged['z'].abs()
      
          top = merged.sort_values(['abs_z', 'geographic_area', 'year'], ascending=[False, True, True]).head(1)
      
          return top[['geographic_area', 'year', 'z', 'acres', 'mean', 'std', 'abs_z']]
